[2026-09-01T19:21:01.575Z] [world] A drafting board stands on legs of scavenged pipe, weighted at each corner against the wind. A gaunt man draws a coastline from memory, slow and certain, like the land owes him the shape.
[2026-09-01T19:21:01.576Z] [arbiter] "Garrin." He doesn't lift the pen. "I map what's left. A runner took a folio of my field charts — the north fords, the sink lines, two years of miles — and went to ground north of here." The pen stops. "I can't redraw what I can't re-walk, and my knees are done walking. Bring the folio back and I'll pay you in the one thing better than a map: the compass I drew
 them with, and coin. I don't sell the originals. Ever."
[2026-09-01T19:21:01.576Z] [system] Answer him from the SPEAK TO GARRIN bar below — or type "accept garrin" or "leave garrin".
[2026-09-01T19:21:01.580Z] [world] A patch of luminous fungus grows in a low pocket of mud. Three colours: pale blue at the centre, copper-orange at the rim, deep violet under the wettest spots.
[2026-09-01T19:21:01.580Z] [world] Halem the Trader pays for fungi by the colour. Blue for clarity. Orange for fire. Violet for the dreaming road.
[2026-09-01T19:21:01.581Z] [reward] ✦ Recovered Bioluminescent Fungus.
[2026-09-01T19:21:01.597Z] [world] The loose end is exactly as loose as you left it.
[2026-09-01T19:21:38.268Z] [player] You take the job.
[2026-09-01T19:21:38.271Z] [arbiter] "North. He camps low — look for ground with no birds over it." Garrin dips the pen. "Miles come back or they don't. Bring my miles back."

[2026-09-01T19:21:53.072Z] [world] A line of three wagons, their axles buried, their canvas tops cracked open by the mud. The horses are gone — pulled free in a panic or eaten in one. The wagons themselves are intact. Whoever drove them packed for a long trip and made it nowhere.
[2026-09-01T19:21:53.072Z] [world] Pinned inside the lead wagon, a hand-drawn map. The destination is circled in red ink: Old Drakova. In the margin, in a different hand: 'the dragon is real. they were not exaggerating. turn back.'
